summary: The voice input's audio worklet path (/audio-worklet-processor.js, unchanged) is now exported as DEFAULT_AUDIO_WORKLET_URL and can be changed with the workletUrl option of the speech adapters, VoiceInputButton and the chat's voice config.
howTo: Nothing to change while the worklet is served at /audio-worklet-processor.js as before. If you serve it elsewhere, you can set voice.workletUrl on the chat or pass workletUrl to the speech adapter; to keep the copy in sync, you can add predev and prebuild scripts that copy node_modules/glirastes/dist/react/audio-worklet-processor.js into public/ (see the speech worklet section of the building-glirastes-chat-ui references).
